# What is each customer really worth?

> Free customer lifetime value predictor for online shops. Upload an order list to get each customer's predicted value, the chance they are still active, at-risk big spenders, what a new customer is worth, and a back-test of the forecast. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
